title: Albeit

inlines.v: ALBE'IT, [This is supposed to be a compound of all, be and it, and is equivalent to admit, or grant it all.] Be it so; admit all that; although; notwithstanding. Whereas ye say, the Lord saith it, albeit I have not spoken. Ezekiel 8:1. [This word is not antiquated.]
